items.claim: Stop parseBody breaking after formData() has been read. A handler calls c.req.formData() and then c.req.parseBody() on the same request.
items.consequence: On this head the second call throws `Failed to parse body as FormData` for multipart bodies, and returns one corrupt key holding re-serialized multipart text for urlencoded bodies; main returns the fields.
items.proposed_fix: In `parseFormData`, read the body with `(request as Request).formData()` again so HonoRequest's `bodyCache` is reused. The media-type guard in `parseBody` alone fixes the mixed-case issue, since the platform parser already accepts mixed-case media types.

items.claim: The platform Request and Response formData() already accept mixed-case media types, so the buffer.ts lowercasing and the parseFormData rewrite are not needed for the fix.
items.consequence: Probe: `new Request(..., {'Content-Type': 'Multipart/Form-Data; boundary=…'}).formData()` yields the field; `new Response(…, 'Application/X-WWW-Form-Urlencoded').formData()` yields `1`; `src/utils/buffer.ts:113`, `src/utils/body.ts:125-132`.

items.claim: The method-override middleware still matches multipart and urlencoded Content-Type case-sensitively; this change does not touch it.
items.consequence: `src/middleware/method-override/index.ts:74` and `:92` use `startsWith` on the raw header.
